besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (the imperative 'Sit daardie twee dinge agter mekaar' and 'jy kry 'n ry van drie').
besluite.rede: Both sides are full main clauses with their own finite verb, so the AWS comma belongs before 'en'; the wording and meaning are unchanged.
The original 'gaan so oor na die bok' is natural Afrikaans; fronting 'So' is a lateral move and can also read as a conclusion ('therefore') rather than 'in this way'.
